title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.9
subtitle: A clear modifier-stack boundary for simulation and collision geometry.

highlights.title: Choose the evaluated input
highlights.description: Modifiers before Cloth NeXt feed simulation or collision export, while modifiers after it remain Blender-only presentation effects.

highlights.title: Use the same boundary for Colliders
highlights.description: Mesh Colliders now show the Cloth NeXt boundary without enabling PC2 playback or requiring a cache file.

highlights.title: Keep user objects untouched
highlights.description: Boundary extraction evaluates an isolated temporary object and preserves the original modifier state, mesh, selection, active object, and mode.
